nuggets.text: Kyle Field drew 107,782 for the opener against Missouri State, the largest season-opening crowd in stadium history.
The Aggies held Missouri State to 67 total yards, the fewest they have allowed since 1978.
The Aggies' safety against Missouri State was their first since Cullen Gillaspia's blocked punt against Alabama in 2017.
Mario Craver has now caught a touchdown pass in three consecutive season openers.
Arizona State is the first current Big 12 team to visit Kyle Field since the Aggies left that league after 2011.
Marcel Reed is 12-1 as a regular-season starter over the last two years.
Aggie students stand all game, ready to play like E. King Gill, who was called from the press box to suit up in 1922.
Reveille outranks every Aggie cadet, and tradition says if she barks during class, the class is dismissed.
Past Reveilles are buried facing the Kyle Field scoreboard, and a mini scoreboard went up when renovations blocked the view.
Aggie Yell Leaders are the only students on campus who earn a varsity letter without playing a sport.
